voice.summary: FATHOM sounds like a quiet engineer: confident in numbers and sparing with adjectives. It lets watts, kilometres and kilograms do the talking, and says arrive fresher where others say faster.
dos: Give the figure with its unit, every time
Speak of the ride, not the technology
Keep claims honest about range and conditions
donts: Do not call it revolutionary or disruptive

taglines: A motor you will forget is there
Seventeen kilos, one hundred twenty kilometres
boilerplate: FATHOM builds the Tern 3, a 17kg aluminium commuter e-bike with a 250W mid-drive motor, a removable 504Wh battery and a range of up to 120km.
